title: Pre-initialize the ArkWeb engine at the application lifecycle boundary
hypothesis: The two late initialization sites can be moved to their owning UIAbility onCreate paths so ArkWeb startup work begins before page construction, while UIContext-dependent node creation and user-agent configuration remain behaviorally unchanged.

editablePaths.reason: Localized late initializeWebEngine call and the UIContext-dependent initialization that must remain after window creation.
Owning application onCreate lifecycle and the later loadContent callback that currently invokes WebUtil.initialize.
Localized component aboutToAppear initialization and dependent user-agent configuration calls.
Owning UIAbility onCreate lifecycle for the selected UserAgent sample.
The Index page links to pages/UserAgent_four but the route is absent from the committed main-pages profile.

contextPaths.reason: Pinned same-API reference call in EntryAbility.onCreate before scheme-handler configuration.
Pinned same-API reference call in Entry1Ability.onCreate before prepareForPageLoad.
Pinned same-API reference call in EntryAbility.onCreate before scheme-handler setup.
Pinned same-API reference call in Entry2Ability.onCreate after cache feature selection.

repair.behavior: The code-workshop application starts ArkWeb engine initialization from BaseAbilityHelper.doOnCreate before window content is loaded and does not repeat the engine call in WebUtil.initialize.
The selected guide application initializes the ArkWeb engine in EntryAbility.onCreate and no longer initializes it from UserAgent_four.aboutToAppear.
The pages/UserAgent_four destination linked by the Index page is registered in the main-pages profile.

preservation.behavior: WebUtil.initialize still binds the window UIContext, clears retained Web state and creates the code-preview Web node only after window content succeeds.
UserAgent_four still reads the default user agent and applies the application-wide and host-specific user-agent configuration after engine initialization.
The four pinned onCreate reference call sites remain byte-identical context and are not participant-editable.

device.behavior: On the frozen Linux Harmony emulator, launching the guide app and selecting UserAgent_four reaches the registered page with an attached Web controller and no white-screen or route error.
On the same environment identity, the code-workshop Web-backed article path reaches its functional UI Oracle after cold launch.

performance.behavior: Repeated cold launches use an identical navigation workload and compare Ability onCreate-to-Web-ready latency only after both functional Oracles pass.
Policy-bound SmartPerf CPU and PSS guardrails remain within the calibrated threshold; unavailable frame, power and thermal signals remain observed-only.
